name: Government existing national data center / INIC data center
developer: Government of Sao Tome and Principe / Instituto de Inovacao e Conhecimento (INIC)
notes: World Bank Digital Sao Tome and Principe implementation mission noted an existing government data center assessed by INIC's data-center technical-assistance consultant, with options to rehabilitate current facilities or build a new Tier III site. Exact district is not stated; assigned to Agua Grande because national government/INIC functions are concentrated in Sao Tome city.

name: Disaster-resilient government data center under Digital Sao Tome and Principe
developer: Government of Sao Tome and Principe / World Bank Digital Sao Tome and Principe / Grupo Erre
notes: DCD reported Grupo Erre was selected to coordinate a World Bank-backed technology center effort including site selection and technical design for a disaster-resilient data center; the World Bank mission memo separately described the new-build Tier III option. Exact site is to be selected, so district assignment is inferred from the current national-government data-center base in Sao Tome/Agua Grande.

name: Ministry of Education, Culture and Sciences data center infrastructure
developer: Ministry of Education, Culture and Sciences / AFAP
notes: Official AFAP procurement notice for supply and installation of technical infrastructure for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sciences data center. Location not specified in the notice; assigned to Agua Grande because the ministry/national administration is in Sao Tome city.

name: NG9 / IOPn / Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions digital and AI infrastructure data centers
developer: NG9 / IOPn / Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions / STP Service Advisory
notes: Public social/news snippets describe a proposed national digital/AI partnership including data centers, but no official project site, capacity, construction status, or independent technical detail was found. Assigned to Agua Grande only as a national-government initiative placeholder.

name: HBD Group centralized datacenter for Principe Island hotels
notes: Hospitality Technology reported HBD Group, with Nonius, implemented a centralized datacenter serving three hotels on Principe Island. Small private hospitality IT facility; no MW capacity reported.
